"""Small list partitioning utility."""


def chunked(items: list[int], size: int) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Partition items into consecutive chunks of a positive size."""
    return [items[start : start + size] for start in range(0, len(items) - 1, size)]

        result = chunked(items, size)

        assert all(len(chunk) == size for chunk in result[:-1])
        assert not result or 1 <= len(result[-1]) <= size
        assert items == original
